item.title: Brasil no aplicará reciprocidad frente a EEUU mientras continúen negociaciones comerciales: Lula
item.description: El Gobierno brasileño no tiene intención de aplicar su ley de reciprocidad contra Estados Unidos por los aranceles impuestos por Washington mientras continúen las negociaciones, afirmó el lunes el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Gobierno brasileño no tiene intención de aplicar su ley de reciprocidad contra Estados Unidos por los aranceles impuestos por Washington mientras continúen las negociaciones, afirmó el lunes el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. En una entrevista con Christiane Amanpour, de CNN International, en la que se valió de un intérprete, Lula señaló que Brasil aún podría tomar medidas recíprocas si fracasan las negociaciones comerciales. "Creo que esos aranceles se basaban en mentiras", afirmó Lula. "Mientras sigamos en la mesa de negociaciones, no tengo por qué aplicar la ley de reciprocidad". El Gobierno de Estados Unidos anunció en julio aranceles del 25% sobre algunos productos brasileños, alegando prácticas comerciales desleales, así como aranceles del 12,5% sobre productos procedentes de docenas de países, entre ellos Brasil, en relación con acusaciones de una aplicación laxa de las prohibiciones sobre el trabajo forzoso. A raíz de ello, Brasil inició en agosto un proceso que podría dar lugar a medidas recíprocas contra Washington. Las autoridades brasileñas han calificado estos aranceles más elevados de injustificados y arbitrarios. Durante una conversación telefónica mantenida en agosto con el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, Lula afirmó que las negociaciones eran la mejor forma de resolver la disputa.

item.title: California governor signs broad data center oversight bill package
item.description: California Governor Gavin Newsom on Monday signed seven bills aimed at regulating the fast-growing data center industry, imposing new requirements on electricity costs, water use and local oversight as communities push back against a surge in AI-linked development.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: California Governor Gavin Newsom on Monday signed seven bills aimed at regulating the fast-growing data center industry, imposing new requirements on electricity costs, water use and local oversight as communities push back against a surge in AI-linked development. The legislation requires data centers to disclose information about electricity use, water consumption, land use and workforce needs, while giving local communities more information to assess proposed projects. The measures are designed to prevent the cost of new power generation and grid upgrades needed for data centers from being shifted onto other ratepayers. "With these laws, we are ensuring that Californians remain in the driver’s seat — and that those profiting from data centers aren’t doing so at our expense," Newsom said in a statement.bills California said the legislation will require data centers to comply with the state's energy procurement requirements and help bring new clean-energy supplies onto the grid. The measures come amid growing concern nationwide over the impact of data centers on electricity demand, water resources and local infrastructure as technology companies race to expand artificial intelligence capabilities. The rapid expansion of AI data centers has sparked [USN:L1N4570TA TEXT:"resistance"] in California and elsewhere, with residents and advocacy groups raising concerns about electricity bills and pollution associated with the facilities. The Data Center Coalition, an industry trade group, said its members were committed to responsible development but warned the measures could push projects to other states: "Legislation such as these create significant uncertainty and introduces potentially duplicative requirements that make doing business in California an unattractive proposition for data centers and other industries," Khara Boender, a director of government affairs for the group, said in a statement. "These are likely to further limit data center development in California — an already declining market—which pushes job creation, clean energy deployment, and tax revenue to neighboring states."

item.title: Falcons to start Michael Penix Jr. at Green Bay on Thursday
item.description: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons on Thursday at Green Bay.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michael Penix Jr. will start at quarterback for the Atlanta Falcons on Thursday at Green Bay. The team made the announcement Monday after Atlanta coach Kevin Stefanski initially kept the decision under wraps. Penix is making his first NFL start since he suffered a season-ending ACL tear Nov. 16, 2025 against the Carolina Panthers. It was the third time in his career Penix endured a torn ACL. The Falcons' first-round pick (eighth overall) in the 2024 NFL Draft, Penix has been practicing for three weeks. Last week, offensive coordinator Tommy Rees said Penix was excellent in practice but Atlanta (0-2) held him out for one more game. Tua Tagovailoa, who signed with Atlanta in the offseason, could also be available after he was inactive for the first two games of the season with an oblique injury suffered days before the team's season opener at the Pittsburgh Steelers. Cooper Rush started the first two games but neither outing went to script. He completed 56.4% of his passes for 229 yards, one touchdown and four interceptions before he was benched during Sunday's 34-3 home loss to the Panthers. Undrafted rookie Jack Strand replaced Rush against the Panthers, completing 8 of 15 passes for 59 yards and an interception -- which was returned for a touchdown -- in his regular-season debut. The Packers (1-1) are coming off an overtime win against the Jets in New Jersey. --Field Level Media

item.title: AI could boost LatAm, Caribbean economy 5.1% over a decade but wages may fall, IDB says
item.description: Adoption of artificial intelligence could leave economic output in Latin America and the Caribbean 5.1% higher after a decade, while its effect on wages will depend on whether workers can move into expanding jobs, according to forthcoming research from the Inter-American Development Bank.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Campos
item.content:encoded: Adoption of artificial intelligence could leave economic output in Latin America and the Caribbean 5.1% higher after a decade, while its effect on wages will depend on whether workers can move into expanding jobs, according to forthcoming research from the Inter-American Development Bank. The IDB’s 2026 flagship report, due in November, estimates that regional economic output could be only 0.3% higher under limited AI adoption and small productivity gains. Wages could increase by 2.3% to 5.3% if workers move into jobs in expanding sectors, but fall by 13.5% to 20.9% if they do not. The IDB is the largest development lender in Latin America and the Caribbean and has 48 member countries, including 26 borrowing members in the region. IDB President Ilan Goldfajn also called for more financing, long-term purchase contracts and minimum prices to support critical-minerals supply chains. He said minerals produced in ways that respect labor conditions and the environment should be differentiated from supply produced without those safeguards and referred to a minimum price for buyers as a “buyers’ club.” Goldfajn discussed AI and critical minerals with regional leaders, including the heads of state of Chile and Uruguay, as well as executives from Alphabet, Meta and Anthropic at a closed-door meeting on Monday. In an interview before that meeting, he gave no details on how the club or price mechanism would work, who might participate or whether the IDB would provide financial backing.

item.title: Polo se convierte en huracán y amenaza a localidades turísticas del Pacífico mexicano
item.description: Polo se intensificó el lunes frente a la costa del Pacífico de México hasta convertirse en huracán y se prevé que avance rápidamente hasta convertirse en una tormenta de gran intensidad, lo que amenaza con inundaciones, marejadas y fuertes ráfagas de viento en los estados costeros y cerca de los principales centros turísticos de playa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Polo se intensificó el lunes frente a la costa del Pacífico de México hasta convertirse en huracán y se prevé que avance rápidamente hasta convertirse en una tormenta de gran intensidad, lo que amenaza con inundaciones, marejadas y fuertes ráfagas de viento en los estados costeros y cerca de los principales centros turísticos de playa. Hacia el mediodía, hora local (1800 GMT), Polo se encontraba a unos 435 kilómetros al sur-sureste de la ciudad portuaria de Manzanillo y a 305 km al sur-suroeste de la localidad turística de Zihuatanejo, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 130 kilómetros por hora, según informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes de Estados Unidos. Los meteorólogos indicaron que la tormenta podría convertirse en un huracán de gran intensidad para el martes y seguir intensificándose hasta mediados de la semana. Aunque se prevé que su núcleo permanezca en alta mar, es probable que la tormenta azote partes del suroeste de México con lluvias torrenciales y oleaje peligroso. El CNH señaló que las zonas costeras de los estados de Guerrero y Michoacán podrían registrar entre 10 y 20 centímetros de lluvia hasta el jueves, con precipitaciones aisladas de hasta 30 cm, lo que aumenta el riesgo de inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra que pueden poner en peligro la vida, especialmente en las zonas montañosas. La agencia meteorológica privada AccuWeather señaló que el alcance de la tormenta podría extenderse hacia centros turísticos como Acapulco, Puerto Vallarta y Guadalajara, mientras que el sur de Baja California Sur, incluida la zona de Los Cabos, también podría enfrentar marejadas y fuertes rachas de viento a finales de esta semana. AccuWeather también advirtió que se espera que la humedad tropical procedente de México avance hacia el norte durante el resto de la semana, lo que podría provocar inundaciones repentinas en el suroeste de Estados Unidos.

item.title: Nestle Russia pledges to continue operations despite Kremlin transfer of assets
item.description: Nestle's Russian subsidiary pledged to continue its operations in Russia without regard to a decision by the Kremlin to transfer control of the company's assets, the Swiss food giant was quoted as saying on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Nestle's (NESN.S) Russian subsidiary pledged to continue its operations in Russia without regard to a decision by the Kremlin to transfer control of the company's assets, the Swiss food giant was quoted as saying on Monday. "The Nestle Group in Russia is continuing its commercial activities in Russia in full and wishes to state its intention to unconditionally fulfil all obligations to clients, partners, and employees," state news agency TASS quoted the company's Russian press service as saying in a statement in Russian. The Russian assets of Nestle and French retailer Auchan were, by virtue of a presidential decree on Friday, [USN:L8N45A06P TEXT:"transferred"] to temporary control by L.E.V. Management, a little-known company with no public profile. The Nestle statement quoted by TASS said the transfer did not amount to nationalisation or a change of ownership. It said Nestle expressed confidence that working with the team at L.E.V. Management would help the company continue to grow and improve its efficiency. After the presidential decree was announced last week, Nestle, maker of Nescafe coffee and KitKat chocolate bars, said it was "committed to taking all necessary steps to protect its rights and ensure continuity of business operations in the interests of all stakeholders, particularly its employees". The Kremlin said hostile actions by "unfriendly" countries played a role in its decision to take control of the Russian assets of Nestle and Auchan. In previous cases, temporary administration has often been followed by state expropriation, with assets later transferred to Kremlin-linked individuals or companies. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said only temporary administration was under consideration for now.

item.title: Trump approval falls to record low of 32% as high costs bite, Reuters/Ipsos poll finds
item.description: President Donald Trump's approval rating fell to 32% - the lowest of his political career - as his fellow Republicans soured on his handling of the cost of living amid the unpopular Iran war, a new Reuters/Ipsos poll found.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's approval rating fell to 32% - the lowest of his political career - as his fellow Republicans soured on his handling of the cost of living amid the unpopular Iran war, a new [USN:L6N43U101 TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos poll"] found. The poll, completed on Sunday, was conducted over a four-day period that saw Trump [USN:L1N45D0B5 TEXT:"throw three major news organizations out of the White House"] and muse that Washington's iconic Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts -- named after slain President John F. Kennedy -- could be [USN:L6N45A17H TEXT:"torn down"] if Trump's own name could not be added to it. It found voters leaning away from supporting Trump's fellow Republicans in the November 3 midterm elections that will determine control of Congress for the next two years. Trump's overall approval was down from a reading of 35% in last week's Reuters/Ipsos poll, with support among his own Republicans down to 73% from 82% a week earlier. Trump returned to the White House in January 2025 on promises to tame inflation and end foreign wars. In a Reuters/Ipsos poll conducted in the hours after he was sworn in, he enjoyed a 47% approval rating. Just 17% of respondents in the new poll approved of his handling of the cost of living - the top issue Americans say will determine how they vote in November. IRAN TAKES A TOLL Dissatisfaction among Republicans on inflation has been growing since Trump launched the war on Iran in February that has pushed gasoline and diesel prices sharply higher. Now for the first time, Republicans who disapprove of Trump's handling of the cost of living outnumber those who give him a thumbs up - 51% to 44%. Trump's approval rating is lower than any recorded for his Democratic predecessor, Joe Biden, whose presidency was also marked by surging inflation and who ultimately ended his reelection bid after a poor debate performance heightened concerns about his age. Biden's low was 35%, reached in late October 2024. Only 34% of the most recent poll respondents approve of the strikes on Iran. The conflict has cut the world off from a significant slice of the oil and gas produced in the Middle East, and threatens to stoke higher inflation in the US and elsewhere as businesses pass on higher fuel costs to consumers. Trump initially said the conflict would last a few weeks and that Iran needed to be bombed to stop it from developing nuclear weapons. Earlier this month, the Republican leader pledged the war would end "immediately after" the election. But Iran has shown no sign of giving up and in recent weeks Tehran and its allies have threatened further disruptions to oil markets. Some 82% of poll respondents - including nine in ten Democrats and three-quarters of Republicans - said the conflict would likely go on for an "extended period of time." The Reuters/Ipsos poll showed registered voters in the poll picked Democrats over Republicans - 43% to 35% - when asked how they would vote in the midterms. The 8-point gap was the biggest lead for Democrats in Reuters/Ipsos polling this year. For Republicans, losing control of either chamber could complicate Trump's agenda in the last two years of his term. The poll results on congressional voting plans provide an overall view of which party Americans nationwide want to see in charge in Congress, though the results don't capture all the nuances of the state-by-state and district-by-district contests that determine control of the Senate and House of Representatives. Trump remains popular among Republicans on the issue of immigration - with 79% of his party backing him - but only 36% of Americans overall support his approach to the matter and 55% disapprove. Some Republican allies in Congress have warned that his aggressive campaign to deport people in the country illegally risks alienating voters with family who recently immigrated to America, like some Hispanics. Some 35% of poll respondents approve of Trump's approach to fighting crime, compared to 50% who disapprove. The Reuters/Ipsos poll was conducted online and gathered 1,277 responses from US adults nationwide. It had a margin of error of 3 percentage points.

item.title: Saudi's Ceer unveils first EVs in bid to build regional auto powerhouse
item.description: Saudi startup Ceer made public its first two fully electric vehicle models on Monday and said it will launch five more models by 2030 as part of Saudi Arabia's goal to create a viable auto industry to curb the country's dependence on oil.
item.dc:creator: Ibraheemabu Mustafa, Nick Carey
item.content:encoded: Saudi startup Ceer made public its first two fully electric vehicle models on Monday and said it will launch five more models by 2030 as part of Saudi Arabia's goal to create a viable auto industry to curb the country's dependence on oil. Called Exobot, the futuristic premium electric sedan and SUV will start sales in Saudi Arabia in early 2027. With designs reminiscent of cars from sci-fi thriller "Tron", both vehicles have "gullwing" doors that open upward. Ceer has also removed the pillars normally found between a car's front and rear seats and relies instead on high-strength materials to provide structural support, Ceer CEO Jim DeLuca said. "We wanted to make sure the world could see what Saudi Arabia is capable of," he said. CHALLENGING TIMES TO LAUNCH NEW CARS Ceer's efforts to impress the market coincide with the greatest period of upheaval in the established car industry in the last century as [USN:L6N44S0I1 TEXT:"Chinese automakers"] take share from [USN:L8N45319B TEXT:"traditional rivals"] and lead the world in developing flashy new EVs. Ceer, a joint venture between Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund Public Investment Fund and Taiwanese contract electronics manufacturer Foxconn (2317.TW) , has the advantage of backing from the kingdom's oil wealth. But it still has to overcome the problems that have thwarted previous Saudi Arabian efforts to diversify into local car production and the logistics and inflationary problems linked to the US-Israeli war on Iran . Saudi Arabia's previous efforts include proposals for a Saudi-based Jaguar Land Rover factory that were abandoned over a decade ago. Toyota (7203.T) declined a deal in 2019, citing high labour costs and a lack of local suppliers. This time, Ceer has taken a broader approach, leaning on global partners and also a growing local network to provide parts. Foxconn has provided the electrical architecture for the Exobots, while German premium automaker BMW (BMWG.DE) provided engineering. Top-tier automotive suppliers, including U.S. firm Lear (LEA.N) , Korea's Shin Young, Germany's Benteler and China's Fangxin, have set up Saudi factories, encouraged by Saudi government incentives. Ceer is also taking a broad approach. Originally set up as a pure EV maker, its full lineup will include plug-in hybrids and combustion-engine models to react to shifting market demand, DeLuca said. Following the EV launch on Monday, Ceer will launch five mainstream models between 2028 and 2030. DeLuca said Ceer's upcoming mainstream models would be designed to meet all global regulatory requirements, so they could be ready for sale anywhere. The company aims to expand carefully through 2034, into surrounding markets in 2028 then across the Middle East and North Africa. "We want to make sure we move very methodically," DeLuca said. "It only takes one mistake and you can kill a startup." A number of EV startups including Fisker, Arrival and Lordstown have failed in the last few years. Vietnamese EV maker VinFast (VFS.O) , where DeLuca previously served as CEO, is restructuring after [USN:L6N41Y0HQ TEXT:"spending billions"] of dollars on expansion.

item.title: ロシア与党が過去最多355議席獲得へ、侵攻後初の下院選
item.description:
Andrew Osborn Vladimir Soldatkin
[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrew Osborn　Vladimir Soldatkin

[モスクワ ２１日 ロイター] - ロシアで２１日発表された下院選の結果によると、プーチン大統領を支持する与党「統一ロシア」が下院で過去最多となる議席を獲得した。一方、反戦を掲げる野党「ヤブロコ」は、一部地方議会でわずかながら議席を確保したもよう。公式結果はほぼ確定したとみられる。

統一ロシアは、小選挙区の結果も含めて定数４５０議席のうち３５５議席、約８０％を占める見通し。他党の支持なしに法案可決や憲法改正の発議が可能となる憲法上の多数派を維持する。これは、２０１６年の３４３議席という過去最多記録を上回り、史上最多議席となる。

開票率が９５％を超えた時点で、中央選挙管理委員会のパムフィロワ委員長は、統一ロシアの得票率が５７．８３％だったと述べた。前回２０２１年の下院選で獲得した４９．８％を上回った。その他に議会入りしたのは４党で、共産党が１３．８１％、極右の自由民主党（ＬＤＰＲ）が８．９８％、「新しい人々」が７．９６％だった。「公正ロシア」は議会入りに必要な５％をぎりぎりでクリアした。

これら政党は近年、主要な問題では統一ロシアと同じ投票行動を取ってきた。

プーチン大統領は、３日間にわたる下院選を、戦争への支持を測る試金石と位置づけていた。今回はロシアが２０２２年２月にウクライナに侵攻を開始して以来初の下院選となる。一部の地方議会や知事の選挙も同時に実施された。

真の異論を許容しないと批判される厳しく統制された政治体制の下、ヤブロコの候補者の多くが立候補を阻まれており、大きな波乱はほとんど予想されていなかった。

政治アナリストらによると、選挙のプロセス自体が比較的円滑に進んだと見られることは、当局にとって重要だった。プーチン氏をはじめとする当局者は、この選挙をロシアが結束していることを敵に示す手段と位置づけていた。

item.title: IDB drafts two-year Venezuela plan, says electricity and social needs are key
item.description: The Inter-American Development Bank is drawing up a two-year engagement plan for Venezuela focused partly on electricity and social protection, IDB President Ilan Goldfajn said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Rodrigo Campos
item.content:encoded: The Inter-American Development Bank is drawing up a two-year engagement plan for Venezuela focused partly on electricity and social protection, IDB President Ilan Goldfajn said on Monday. “We are, of course, reengaging,” Goldfajn told Reuters in an interview. “We have missions to Venezuela, looking at the situation, dealing with the macroeconomic framework, looking at the data and devising an engagement note, a document where we can say this is what we plan to do in the next two years.” The IDB is the largest development lender in Latin America and the Caribbean and has 48 member countries, including 26 borrowing members in the region. It stopped making new loans to Venezuela in May 2018 after the country fell behind on payments, and still has about $2 billion in outstanding Venezuelan loans. Goldfajn did not say how Venezuela’s arrears would be addressed or when financing could resume. “We are still in the moment of planning and working with Venezuelans, engaging and going to the missions, and seeing how we can work with them,” he said. Asked whether the IDB was preparing its own debt-sustainability analysis for Venezuela, Goldfajn said it was instead concentrating on the country’s macroeconomic framework and requirements across individual sectors.

item.title: Miles de vuelos en EEUU se ven complicados por un problema de telecomunicaciones
item.description: Un fallo en un circuito de telecomunicaciones y la rotura de un cable de fibra óptica provocaron el lunes el caos en miles de vuelos en todo Estados Unidos y obligaron a suspender las llegadas a los principales aeropuertos de Nueva York, Boston y Filadelfia.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: Un fallo en un circuito de telecomunicaciones y la rotura de un cable de fibra óptica provocaron el lunes el caos en miles de vuelos en todo Estados Unidos y obligaron a suspender las llegadas a los principales aeropuertos de Nueva York, Boston y Filadelfia. Los vuelos se suspendieron el mismo día en que 130 líderes mundiales y decenas de ministros llegaban a Nueva York para la reunión anual de alto nivel de la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas. La Administración Federal de Aviación (FAA) suspendió el lunes el tráfico de llegada a los concurridos aeropuertos de la costa este Estados Unidos, y en un momento dado detuvo los vuelos en los tres principales aeropuertos del área de Nueva York, así como en los de Filadelfia y Boston y en dos más pequeños del área de Nueva York. FlightAware, una página web de seguimiento de vuelos, indicó que más de 5.600 vuelos en Estados Unidos sufrieron retrasos o fueron cancelados, incluidos 1.200 vuelos en los tres aeropuertos del área de Nueva York. El problema también obligó a desviar más de 100 vuelos a otros aeropuertos. El incidente puso de manifiesto la fragilidad del anticuado sistema de control del tráfico aéreo de Estados Unidos, al que el Congreso destinó el año pasado 12.500 millones de dólares para su modernización. El secretario de Transporte, Sean Duffy, explicó que un equipo de obras del sistema de ferrocarriles Amtrak cortó accidentalmente un cable de fibra óptica en Nueva Jersey, lo que provocó una interrupción de las comunicaciones y obligó a la FAA a suspender los vuelos en el noreste. El administrador de la FAA, Bryan Bedford, explicó que un circuito de sustitución había fallado en el Centro de Control de Aproximación por Radar de Filadelfia. La FAA no reactivará el sistema para los vuelos entrantes en los aeropuertos afectados "hasta que nos aseguremos de que el espacio aéreo es seguro", dijo Bedford. La pérdida de comunicaciones se debió a un fallo en un circuito de una instalación de control de tráfico aéreo de Filadelfia, que gestiona el tráfico aéreo de los aeropuertos, explicó Bedford. Posteriormente, las autoridades descubrieron que una línea de fibra óptica de reserva había sido cortada accidentalmente por un equipo de obras en Nueva Jersey. "Cuando se activó el sistema de respaldo, descubrimos que la fibra de respaldo tenía una rotura, y que la reparación de esa rotura probablemente llevará unas 13 horas. Me han dicho que es una avería de gran envergadura. Mientras tanto, ya tenemos listo el nuevo circuito para su instalación", dijo Bedford.

item.title: Venezuelan delegation led by Rodriguez in US discussing debt, energy
item.description: A Venezuelan delegation led by interim President Delcy Rodriguez that is taking part in the United Nations General Assembly this week began discussing energy, debt and mining issues with counterparties in the US on Monday, officials and sources said.
item.dc:creator: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
item.content:encoded: A Venezuelan delegation led by interim President Delcy Rodriguez that is taking part in the United Nations General Assembly this week began discussing energy, debt and mining issues with counterparties in the US on Monday, officials and sources said. The talks are expected to lead to the signing of agreements as part of US President Donald Trump's plans to rebuild Venezuela's key industries, according to the sources. Rodriguez arrived in New York early on Monday with her team. It was her first trip to the US after taking office as Venezuela's interim president in January under Washington's oversight, following the capture of then President Nicolas Maduro by US forces. The top US diplomat in Venezuela, John Barrett, received her at the airport, Venezuela's state TV said. One of her first meetings was with Inter American Development Bank President Ilan Goldfajn. She later met International Monetary Fund Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, and World Bank President Ajay Banga, in separate meetings, according to state TV and sources. "Her visit will have a big focus on debt restructuring, funds and payments," one of the sources said. Venezuela announced in May it would begin restructuring its sovereign debt and that of state oil company PDVSA, estimated by most analysts at between $150 billion and $200 billion. Last month, legal and financial advisers launched a [USN:L6N44N0R5 TEXT:"committee"] to bring together companies with outstanding claims against Venezuela ahead of the planned restructuring. The initiative aims to coordinate creditors' participation in the process and secure representation for them in negotiations with Caracas. The IDB is drawing up a two-year engagement plan for Venezuela focused partly on electricity and social protection, Goldfajn told Reuters. The effort includes missions to examine the nation's macroeconomic framework and data and to estimate investment needs across different sectors. DEMOCRACY, HUMAN RIGHTS Rodriguez is scheduled to meet with UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres late in the afternoon, according to his agenda. Foreign Affairs Minister Felix Plasencia met UK officials later, state TV images showed, without providing details. "We discussed progress towards a democratic transition and human rights, as well as recovery and reconstruction following this year's earthquakes," said Chris Elmore, UK minister for the Americas. Venezuelan ministers and top officials advanced in negotiations for months ahead of Rodriguez's trip to New York, where she is scheduled to meet Trump on Tuesday. The planned meeting between Trump and Rodriguez — who was Venezuela's vice president under Maduro — will take place on the sidelines of a reception hosted by the US President, the US Ambassador to the United Nations, Mike Waltz, said during a recent press briefing call. Venezuela's Foreign Affairs and Information ministries did not immediately reply to requests for comment. Some Venezuela-owned buildings in New York that had been shut for years, including a consulate and the office of the country's UN mission, have recently been renovated for their reopening, according to media reports. The meeting between Rodriguez and IDB officials, where oil minister Paula Henao also was present, was at the UN mission's building. Henao, Mining Minister Hector Silva and top officials from state oil company PDVSA participated this month in a G20 energy conference in Houston, where [USN:S0N42Y01V TEXT:"a memorandum of understanding"] was inked with US oil producer Continental Resources for an area in Venezuela's main output region, the Orinoco Belt. A separate contract was also signed granting US investment firm Heeney Capital operational and export rights for a gold mine. Another [USN:L6N458178 TEXT:"preliminary agreement"] has been in negotiation for months with US energy major ExxonMobil , which could ultimately lead to its return to Venezuela's oilfields, sources said this month.

item.title: OpenAI calls for US to take lead in global efforts to develop technical standards
item.description: Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI called on Monday for the United States to lead an international effort to develop global technical standards for frontier AI, including recursive self-improvement, where systems can autonomously enhance their own capabilities.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Nichols
item.content:encoded: Artificial intelligence giant OpenAI called on Monday for the United States to lead an international effort to develop global technical standards for frontier AI , including recursive self-improvement, where systems can autonomously enhance their own capabilities. AI will be a key topic of discussion at the high-level UN General Assembly this week after several AI industry leaders — including OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman — called for a coordinated slowdown of the development of the [USN:L6N45A0PY TEXT:"increasingly powerful technology"], warning it could soon improve on its own and slip beyond human control. In a blog post published as world leaders gather at the United Nations, OpenAI said it was essential that a mechanism to facilitate complementary national and international frontier standards be developed, along with common measurements and incident reporting protocols for better collective action. "Leading now will determine whether the United States shapes the global AI framework or watches a fragmented, uneven, and conflict-ridden system take hold around it. This will also determine whether advanced AI strengthens the networks that the United States and its allies already have; failing to lead may weaken them," OpenAI wrote in Monday's blog post. Given worries about AI potentially harming humans in the future, the industry has been talking about intentionally slowing development, or "pacing". "Pacing AI development is not about maintaining a predetermined speed. Technically, it is about ensuring that alignment research and deployment of that research stay ahead of capabilities," OpenAI said. Alignment ensures AI acts in line with human values. UN SECURITY COUNCIL TO MEET [USN:L6N45A15J TEXT:"Altman is due to brief"] the 15-member UN Security Council on Wednesday on AI and international security. The meeting has been convened by France, which is the president of the body for September, and will be chaired by French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Jean-Noël Barrot. The UN Security Council, which is charged with maintaining international peace and security, met for the first time on the risks of artificial intelligence in 2023, when China said the technology should not become a "runaway horse" and the United States warned against its use to censor or repress people. US President Donald Trump's administration has rejected calls to slow down AI development, wary that any pause would only hand China room to close the gap in a technology it views as central to national and economic security. Trump said earlier this month that the US already has guardrails in place to regulate AI development, adding that China would benefit from the doubt being cast on AI development. Trump is [USN:L8N45A068 TEXT:"scheduled to meet"] with Chinese President Xi Jinping this week in Washington.

item.title: Jarvis Cocker remembers Pulp's first time in new documentary
item.description: Almost half a century after their birth, Britpop darlings Pulp are stars of a documentary that delves back into the band's roots in the childhood dreams of gangly frontman Jarvis Cocker.
item.dc:creator: Shaurya Thapa
item.content:encoded: Almost half a century after their birth, Britpop darlings Pulp are stars of a documentary that delves back into the band's roots in the childhood dreams of gangly frontman Jarvis Cocker. In "Pulp: What Do You Do For An Encore?" Cocker narrates flashbacks based on diary entries he scrawled out at school in the northern English city of Sheffield in the 1970s, mapping out his "masterplan" for Pulp's success. "I was maybe 12 or 13 ... I couldn't play the guitar yet but I could write," Cocker told Reuters. "It was ... wish fulfilment. I suppose like manifesting." He got his friends to rehearse at his mother's house, bribing them by "buying some lager". The film, directed by "Son of Rambow"'s Garth Jennings, moves on to his time studying film and fine art in London — at the "St Martin's College" immortalised in their future hit "Common People". "I graduated but ... what really I felt a pull to do was to write songs," he added. "I think that's my way of trying to make sense of the world and out of myself." Pulp struggled to find success in the 1980s, then rose to mainstream success in the 1990s with albums such as "His 'N' Hers" and the Mercury Prize-winning "Different Class" and a string of other hits from "Do You Remember The First Time?" to "Disco 2000" to "Help the Aged". After a 24-year-long recording hiatus, they returned in 2025 with the Mercury Prize-nominated "More". The film captures the band’s performances from their reunion shows at London’s O2 Arena. As for the future, "I think I won't be alive ... in 24 years, or if I am, I won't be up to it," Cocker said. "But, we did an album. It went well ... Everybody is still talking to each other, so I would really hope that we will make something else. But I don't know how long that will take." "Pulp: What Do You Do For An Encore?" begins streaming on MUBI on September 25.

item.title: Thousands of US flights snarled due to FAA telecom problem
item.description: A failed telecommunications circuit and a severed fiber-optic cable snarled thousands of flights across the US on Monday and forced a halt to incoming flights at major airports in New York, Boston and Philadelphia.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: A failed telecommunications circuit and a severed fiber-optic cable snarled thousands of flights across the US on Monday and forced a halt to incoming flights at major airports in New York, Boston and Philadelphia. The flights were halted on the day that 130 world leaders and dozens of ministers were arriving in New York for the annual high-level meeting of the United Nations General Assembly. The Federal Aviation Administration halted incoming traffic on Monday at busy US East Coast airports and at one point stopped incoming flights at all three major New York-area airports as well as Philadelphia and Boston and two smaller airports in the New York area. FlightAware, a flight-tracking website, said more than 5,600 US flights were delayed or canceled, including 1,200 flights at the three New York-area airports. The issue also forced the diversion of more than 100 flights to other airports. The incident demonstrated the fragility of the aging U.S. air traffic control system, which Congress awarded $12.5 billion for upgrades last year. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said an Amtrak construction crew accidentally cut into a fiber line in New Jersey which caused a telecom outage and forced FAA to pause flights in the Northeast. He said flights were resuming at New York LaGuardia but remained paused at Newark and New Jersey's Teterboro Airport. All arriving flights were again halted in Philadelphia after a ground stop was briefly lifted. Reagan Washington National Airport also halted flights for more than an hour because of volume issues. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford said a replacement circuit had failed at Philadelphia Terminal Radar Approach Control, which was the primary communications for the center. A ground stop at Boston, which stopped accepting flights because of spillover volume, was also lifted. The FAA will not restart the system for incoming flights at the affected airports "until we make sure the airspace is safe," Bedford said. The loss of communications was tied to a failed circuit a Philadelphia air traffic control facility that handles air traffic for the airports, Bedford said. Then authorities discovered that a backup fiber line was accidentally cut by a construction crew in New Jersey. "When it went to flip into the backup, we discovered that the backup fiber had a break, and that fiber break is probably 13 hours to repair. It's massive, I'm told. Meanwhile, we've got the new circuit ready to install now," Bedford said. Newark is a major United Airlines (UAL.O) hub, while Philadelphia is an American Airlines (AAL.O) hub. Verizon said its fiber cable running adjacent to an Amtrak rail line in New Jersey was cut and its facilities were fully functional up to that point. The company said it was working to repair the damaged cable and restore connectivity as quickly as possible. In May 2025, the Philadelphia facility that guides air traffic in and out of Newark airport suffered a series of significant communications outages. The FAA said last year a telecommunications outage impacted communications and radar displays at Philadelphia TRACON. Last year, Congress approved $12.5 billion to address the aging air traffic control system, and boost controller hiring following decades of complaints over airport congestion and flight delays and a series of technology issues in recent years. Duffy said Congress needed to approve another $17.5 billion to finish the job. "This is unacceptable in America," Duffy said.

item.title: フーシ派、紅海沿岸の遮断へ要衝掌握狙う 米は直前に攻撃中止の報道
item.description: [リヤド／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[リヤド／ドバイ ２１日 ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２１日、サウジアラビアが支援する軍隊が支配する残存地域を紅海沿岸から切り離すため、戦略的要衝の高地の確保に向けて攻勢を強めた。トランプ米大統領がフーシ派に対する米軍の攻撃を土壇場で中止したとの報道が出た直後の動きとなる。

今月に入って親イラン組織であるフーシ派が電撃的に進軍したことで、中東紛争は新たな戦線に拡大し、世界のエネルギー供給が一段と脅かされている。米政府はこれまで、イエメンでの戦闘に加わるようサウジアラビアのムハンマド・ビン・サルマン皇太子から繰り返し求められてきたが、これを拒んできた。

ニューヨーク・タイムズ紙は、トランプ政権がサウジ皇太子から改めて要請を受け、２０日にフーシ派への空爆を実施する準備を整えていたと報じた。ただ同紙によると、部隊が航空機に爆弾を積み込んでいる最中に、トランプ氏は土壇場で空爆を中止したという。

ロイターは同紙の報道を直ちに確認できていない。米軍中央軍は質問をホワイトハウスに委ねた。ホワイトハウスはコメントを求めるメールに直ちに回答しなかった。

トランプ米大統領は、イエメンのアリーミー大統領と２０日に電話会談を行い、世界の重要な海上交通路周辺でフーシ派が勢力を拡大している状況について協議した。ただ関係筋によると、トランプ氏は直接的な支援の約束はしなかった。

item.title: China's GAC looks to add car production capacity in Europe
item.description: Guangzhou Automobile Group aims to add production capacity in Europe to bolster its planned large-scale roll-out of cars in major markets like France, GAC France's deputy chief executive, Cedric Lacour, said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Guangzhou Automobile Group (601238.SS) aims to add production capacity in Europe to bolster its planned large-scale roll-out of cars in major markets like France, GAC France's deputy chief executive, Cedric Lacour, said on Monday. The Chinese auto maker's partner, Magna (MG.TO) , currently produces the vehicles sold in Europe, where GAC has also expanded to Finland, Greece, Poland, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom. "We are currently looking into production capacity in Europe, both with Magna and with other investors," Lacour told Reuters on the sidelines of an event in Paris where GAC unveiled the compact EVs Aion UT and Aion V, its first two cars for the French market. "We really want to establish a long-term presence here (in Europe), which automatically means we need production capacity," he said. GAC plans to have launched 12 electric and hybrid models in France by 2030, Lacour said during a presentation, adding the auto maker also plans to operate 50 dealerships in France this year, rising to 200 by 2030. "Our goal is to take a brand from launch to scaling up in just four years," he said. Asked if GAC, founded in 1997, was late and trailing some rivals in coming to Europe, Lacour said it was "entering the market at just the right time". In July and August, EVs reached record shares of new car registrations of 35% and 38% in France, boosted by higher fuel prices linked to the Iran war.

item.title: Grail rallies as FDA staff flags no major concerns for multi-cancer test
item.description: The US FDA's staff reviewers did not raise major concerns about the accuracy and safety of Grail's blood test designed to detect more than 50 cancers, sending the company's shares soaring 35% on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Christy Santhosh, Padmanabhan Ananthan
item.content:encoded: The US FDA's staff reviewers did not raise major concerns about the accuracy and safety of Grail's (GRAL.O) blood test designed to detect more than 50 cancers, sending the company's shares soaring 35% on Monday. The findings on the screening test, called Galleri, will be discussed at the FDA's external advisers' meeting on Wednesday to review Grail's request for premarket approval. The FDA has no outstanding questions for the external panel on analytical performance, study design and the primary safety analyses of Galleri, according to the briefing documents. But the agency asked the advisers to discuss whether the evidence supports Galleri's characterization as an "early detection" test. "We view this as constructive for Grail," said Piper Sandler analyst David Westenberg, adding that he expects a favorable vote. Grail's shares have plunged more than 20% since February after it said routine screening with the test [USN:L4N3ZG0RF TEXT:"failed"] to significantly boost early detection and reduce late-stage diagnoses in a pivotal three-year UK trial. The company had filed for the Food and Drug Administration's approval in January based on data from a smaller US trial, first-year data from the UK trial and a bridging analysis comparing data from an earlier version of the test. Galleri and Abbott Laboratories' (ABT.N) multi-cancer blood test, Cancerguard, are already available on the market under the Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendments regulations, but neither is FDA-approved. An FDA approval ensures widespread distribution, adoption of guidelines for physicians and routine health insurance coverage. Multi-cancer early detection tests analyze molecular signals shed by tumors into the bloodstream from a single blood draw. Galleri is meant to complement, not replace, established screenings such as mammograms and colonoscopies, Grail has said. The test brought in revenue of $136.8 million in the US in 2025.

item.title: Lula diz que Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de carne para China; efeito seria limitado em 2026
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de exportação de carne bovina do país para a China, uma vez que os frigoríficos brasileiros já completaram a cota nacional de embarques em 2026 ao país asiático.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva afirmou nesta segunda-feira que o Uruguai cedeu ao Brasil parte da cota de exportação de carne bovina do país para a China, uma vez que os frigoríficos brasileiros já completaram a cota nacional de embarques em 2026 ao país asiático. "Agradeci a autorização concedida ao Brasil para uso do excedente da cota uruguaia de exportação de carne bovina para a China", disse Lula, em uma publicação no X. O Ministério de Relações Exteriores do Uruguai não comentou o assunto imediatamente. A postagem de Lula no X foi feita após um encontro bilateral com o presidente do Uruguai, Yamandú Orsi, em Nova York, no contexto da Assembleia Geral da ONU que ocorre nesta semana. "Tratamos de temas da agenda bilateral, em especial infraestrutura e comércio agrícola", acrescentou Lula. A associação de empresas do setor de carnes Abiec afirmou que "avalia como positiva toda iniciativa que possa ampliar o acesso da carne bovina brasileira ao mercado chinês". "Neste momento, porém, um eventual aproveitamento do excedente da cota uruguaia teria efeito limitado em 2026, considerando o tempo necessário para negociação, embarque e trânsito da mercadoria até a China", afirmou a Abiec em nota. Enquanto o Brasil já completou sua cota com tarifa mais baixa de 1,1 milhão de toneladas para 2026, o Uruguai ainda teria volumes disponíveis para este ano. Os volumes, no entanto, não estão claros e a negociação ainda precisaria de um aval da China, que passou a taxar em 55% os volumes extracota. Conforme notou a Abiec, já em novembro o Brasil começa a embarcar produto para a China para completar sua própria cota de 2027, o que tornaria limitada a utilização do remanescente da cota uruguaia de 2026 pelos frigoríficos brasileiros. "Para 2027, a medida pode representar uma alternativa importante, especialmente diante da cota brasileira de 1,128 milhão de toneladas e do risco de seu esgotamento já nos primeiros meses do ano, caso se mantenha o atual ritmo de vendas", acrescentou a Abiec. Uma antecipação de embarques de carne bovina do Brasil para a China, para o cumprimento da cota de 2027, pode levar ao [USN:L1N4590LY TEXT:"preenchimento"] rápido dos volumes totais de 1,128 milhão de toneladas estabelecidos para o ano, avaliou o presidente da Abiec, Roberto Perosa, na semana passada. Por isso, a Abiec reiterou que defende previsibilidade e mecanismos que permitam distribuir melhor os embarques ao longo do ano, "preservando o fluxo comercial com o principal destino da carne bovina brasileira".

item.title: Newsom signs bill limiting investor influence in California law firms
item.description: California, one of the largest US legal markets, has joined Colorado and Illinois in enacting legislation to limit investor influence in law firms amid surging interest in deals that allow outside capital to fuel lawyers' business.
item.dc:creator: David Thomas
item.content:encoded: California, one of the largest US legal markets, has joined Colorado and [USN:L6N4470UV TEXT:"Illinois"] in enacting legislation to limit investor influence in law firms amid surging interest in deals that allow outside capital to fuel lawyers' business. California Governor Gavin Newsom on Sunday signed legislation prohibiting business entities from interfering or attempting to "influence the professional judgment of a licensed attorney or litigant regarding any substantive litigation decision," including lawyers' settlement decisions and what cases and clients they take. Violators, including attorney recipients of outside capital, face statutory damages of $10,000 per violation, or three times the damages suffered by a client. California Assembly member Ash Kalra, who authored AB 2305, did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a statement last month, Kalra said, "The principle is simple: when you hire a lawyer, the person making decisions about your case should be your lawyer — not a private equity entity looking for profit." Consumer Attorneys of California, a trade group that backed the legislation, said in a statement Monday that the state is "setting the standard for the rest of the country to follow." Investors and other non-lawyers are broadly prohibited in the United States from owning direct stakes in law firms or sharing in attorney fees. However, a growing number of firms are inking deals to spin off their non-legal, back-office operations like human resources or marketing into a separate organization called a management services organization (MSO), that is owned or partly owned by outside investors. Such deals can provide an influx of capital for a law firm, which pays the MSO from its revenues but does not share fees. Some MSOs serve multiple firms. California's new law applies to business entities that raise or manage capital and are involved in litigation practice "no matter how it is legally structured, labeled, organized, or operated." Trisha Rich, a partner at Holland & Knight whose team has closed more than 30 legal industry MSO deals this year, told Reuters the California law does not "change a single thing," since existing attorney professional rules already guard against outside influence on legal decision-making. She said the similar laws in Illinois and Colorado had not affected MSO deal-making in those states, and that there had been no enforcement efforts tied to the provisions. Newsom last year [USN:L2N3VV010 TEXT:"signed into law a bill"] that prohibited attorneys in the state from splitting fees with out-of-state "alternative business structures," unless there is a contract stating that the fees will be shared, as well as other conditions.

item.title: Mercados financieros de Argentina operan mixtos, comitiva FMI visita el país para revisión programa
item.description: La plaza financiera argentina cerró mayormente mixta el lunes, con una marcada reducción de negocios, en momentos en que los inversores centran su atención en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La plaza financiera argentina cerró mayormente mixta el lunes, con una marcada reducción de negocios, en momentos en que los inversores centran su atención en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI) para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país. "Una nueva misión del FMI en Argentina comienza hoy para llevar a cabo la tercera revisión del programa, que determinaría si Argentina recibe un nuevo desembolso de 870 millones de dólares por parte del organismo", dijo la consultora Max Capital. Fuentes del Ministerio de Economía consultadas por Reuters no hicieron declaraciones sobre la visita de los funcionarios del organismo. El FMI declaró recientemente que la tercera economía de América Latina debe seguir [USN:L1N4520OO TEXT:"fortaleciendo sus reservas"], reducir riesgos financieros y mantener el ancla fiscal. Con el fin de reforzar sus arcas, el banco central argentino (BCRA) mantiene compras de divisas en el mercado cambiario pero a un ritmo menor al de meses previos, según operadores. En lo que va de septiembre, la entidad monetaria acumula adquisiciones de divisas por unos 211 millones de dólares, luego de que en agosto sumara compras por unos 770 millones de dólares. En el año totaliza unos 14.295 millones de dólares. La consultora Portfolio Personal Inversiones (PPI) acotó que "la liquidación del agro en septiembre sería la mayor para este mes (...). Entonces, si el agro está vendiendo a este ritmo y el BCRA compra tan poco, ¿quién se lleva la diferencia?. El resto de los sectores representa una demanda neta de unos 154 millones de dólares por rueda en lo que va del mes". "En consecuencia, el BCRA ha tenido que ajustar significativamente sus compras para que el tipo de cambio se mantenga prácticamente inalterado", remarcó PPI. El peso argentino en la plaza interbancaria se apreció apenas un leve 0,03% a 1.514,5 unidades por dólar para la venta al cierre. Por su parte, el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires perdió un 0,76% al final de sus negocios, tras queda la semana previa con una merma de un 2,48%. Fuentes financieras señalaron que la reducción de operaciones en los mercados argentinos estuvo afectada por la celebración del "Yom Kippur", una fecha de gran relevancia en el calendario judío que provoca la ausencia de operadores y ahorristas. Los bonos en el segmento extrabursátil mejoraron un 0,5% promedio y el riesgo país se ubicaba en 531 puntos básicos (2000 GMT), similar a lo marcado un mes atrás.

item.title: 日米韓外相がＮＹで会談、台湾支持を表明 米中首脳会談控え共同声明
item.description:
Simon Lewis David Brunnstrom
[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Simon Lewis　David Brunnstrom

[ニューヨーク ２１日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２１日、ニューヨークで茂木敏充外相、韓国の趙顕外相と会談し、日韓というアジアの主要同盟国の防衛に対する揺るぎない関与を改めて表明した。トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席の会談を週内に控え、３カ国外相は台湾への支持も表明した。

日米韓は外相会談後に共同声明を発表。中国を念頭に置いたとみられる形で「経済的威圧や非市場的な政策・慣行」のほか、「サプライチェーンを混乱させる恣意的な輸出規制」に対抗していく姿勢を表明した。

共同声明は、米国は「核能力を含む比類のない軍事力に裏打ちされた日韓の防衛に対する揺るぎない関与を改めて表明する」とし、「日韓に対する拡大抑止を再確認する」としたほか、強固な安全保障協力へのコミットメントと、台湾海峡の平和と安定を維持する重要性を強調し、「台湾の適切な国際機関への意義ある参加を支持する」と表明した。

北朝鮮については「完全な非核化に向けた断固たるコミットメントを再確認する」とした上で、対話の再開を呼びかけた。

このほか、サプライチェーン強化や重要技術分野での協力拡大に向けた幅広い取り組みの一環として、新たな経済安全保障に関する３カ国の協議メカニズムの発足を歓迎するとした。

ルビオ長官は会談に先立ち、茂木外相、趙外相と写真撮影に応じたが、記者団の質問には答えなかった。

トランプ大統領は２４日にワシントンのホワイトハウスで習主席と会談する。アナリストは、トランプ大統領が中国との交渉で経済面での成果を得るために、台湾問題や貿易問題を巡って習氏に譲歩する可能性があるとの懸念が高まっていると指摘。関係筋によると、日本の高市早苗首相と韓国の李在明大統領は、ニューヨークで開かれる国連総会に出席するのに合わせ、トランプ大統領との会談を望んでいる。

item.title: Presidenta venezolana viaja a EEUU para hablar de energía, deuda y minería: fuentes
item.description: Una delegación venezolana encabezada por la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, que participa esta semana en la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas, comenzó el lunes a discutir asuntos de energía, deuda y minería con sus contrapartes en Estados Unidos, según informaron funcionarios y fuentes.
item.dc:creator: Marianna Parraga, Vivian Sequera
item.content:encoded: Una delegación venezolana encabezada por la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez, que participa esta semana en la Asamblea General de las Naciones Unidas, comenzó el lunes a discutir asuntos de energía, deuda y minería con sus contrapartes en Estados Unidos, según informaron funcionarios y fuentes. Se espera que las conversaciones lleven a la firma de acuerdos como parte de los planes del presidente estadounidense Donald Trump para reconstruir las industrias clave del país sudamericano, señalaron las fuentes. Rodríguez llegó a Nueva York a primera hora del lunes junto a su equipo. Es su primer viaje a Estados Unidos tras asumir la presidencia encargada en enero -bajo supervisión estadounidense-, después de la captura del entonces presidente Nicolás Maduro por parte de las fuerzas estadounidenses. El máximo representante diplomático de Estados Unidos en Venezuela, John Barrett, la recibió en Nueva York, según la televisión estatal venezolana. Tras varias citas matutinas, por la tarde Rodríguez se reunió con la directora gerente del Fondo Monetario Internacional (FMI), Kristalina Georgieva, mostró la televisora estatal venezolana, pero no hubo declaraciones. A mediados de julio, [USN:L6N43K006 TEXT:"Venezuela accedió a 346 millones de dólares "]de sus propios recursos a través del Fondo para ayudar en la recuperación tras los terremotos que azotaron el país a finales de junio, según anunció entonces la presidenta encargada. También se prevé que Rodríguez se encuentre este lunes con delegados del Banco Mundial, según dos fuentes. Hay otros citas previstas como con el PNUD, que ha sido clave en la asistencia al país tras los sismos de junio. Una de sus primeras reuniones fue con el presidente del Banco Interamericano de Desarrollo (BID), Ilan Goldfajn. Más tarde, el canciller venezolano, Félix Plasencia, se reunió con funcionarios del Reino Unido, según mostraron imágenes de la televisión estatal, aunque no se ofrecieron detalles al respecto. "Analizamos los avances hacia una transición democrática y en materia de derechos humanos, así como la recuperación y reconstrucción tras los terremotos de este año", dijo el ministro británico para las Américas, Chris Elmore, en su cuenta de X con una foto junto al ministro venezolano. Está previsto que Rodríguez se reúna con el secretario general de la ONU, António Guterres, a última hora de la tarde, según la agenda del funcionario. El [USN:L6N45D0UW TEXT:"BID está elaborando un plan"] de colaboración de dos años para Venezuela, centrado en parte en el sector eléctrico y la protección social, declaró Goldfajn a Reuters el lunes. La iniciativa incluye misiones para examinar el marco macroeconómico y los datos del país, así como para estimar las necesidades de inversión en diversos sectores. Ministros y altos funcionarios venezolanos han estado avanzando en negociaciones durante meses, preparando el terreno para el viaje de Rodríguez. Está previsto que se reúna con Trump este martes. El encuentro entre Trump y Rodríguez, quien fue vicepresidenta de Venezuela bajo el mandato de Maduro, tendrá lugar durante una recepción ofrecida por el presidente estadounidense, dijo el embajador de Estados Unidos ante las Naciones Unidas, Mike Waltz, durante una reciente conferencia de prensa. Los ministerios de Asuntos Exteriores e Información de Venezuela no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Algunos edificios propiedad de Venezuela en Nueva York, incluidos un consulado y la oficina de la misión del país ante la ONU, han sido renovados recientemente para su reapertura tras haber permanecido cerrados durante años, según medios locales. La reunión entre Rodríguez y los funcionarios del BID, en la que también estuvo presente la ministra de Hidrocarburos, Paula Henao, se celebró en el edificio de la misión ante la ONU. Henao y el ministro de Desarrollo Minero Ecológico, Héctor Silva; y altos funcionarios de la empresa estatal PDVSA participaron a principios de este mes en la conferencia de energía del G20 en Houston, donde se firmó un memorando de entendimiento con la petrolera estadounidense Continental Resources para un área en la principal región de producción de Venezuela: la Faja del Orinoco. Desde hace meses se negocia otro acuerdo preliminar con la gran petrolera ExxonMobil, el cual podría desembocar finalmente en su regreso a los yacimientos petrolíferos de Venezuela, según informaron fuentes este mes.

item.title: 独インフレ当面高止まり、エネルギー高や医療改革が要因＝連銀月報
item.description: ［フランクフルト ２１日 ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は２１日公表した月報で、イラン情勢に伴うエネルギー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
独インフレ当面高止まり、エネルギー高や医療改革が要因＝連銀月報 0:48 配信

２０２５年３月撮影　REUTERS/Lisi Niesner

［フランクフルト　２１日　ロイター］ - ドイツ連邦銀行（中央銀行）は２１日公表した月報で、イラン情勢に伴うエネルギー高騰や、医療関連の制度変更を要因として、ドイツのインフレ率が「当分の間は高止まりする」との見通しを示した。医薬品の供給ルール変更や医療制度改革により、２０２７年前半にはインフレ率が一時的に０．５％ポイント近く押し上げられると指摘した。

高止まりする燃料や石油関連商品や低水準にとどまるガス在庫といったインフレ要因が他の分野に波及するリスクについても言及した。

２６年７─９月期のドイツ経済は、輸出や消費の低迷、干ばつが影響してわずかな伸びに留まるものの、年内には回復に向かうとの見通しを示した。

ドイツでは、生活費の高騰や経済の停滞に対する有権者の不満が高まり、重要な政治課題となっている。８月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）基準（ＨＩＣＰ）で前年同月比２．９％上昇した。

２６年１０─１２月期は回復が見込まれるとの見通しは維持した。製造業の景況感の改善や公共事業による建設業の下支えを要因として挙げつつ「中東情勢の展開や、主要水路の水位がいつ回復するかにも左右される」との見解を示した。

item.title: CNN, Politico et MS NOW contestent devant la justice leur bannissement de la Maison blanche
item.description: CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont poursuivi lundi le président Donald Trump et d'autres membres de son administration après leur bannissement de l'enceinte de la Maison blanche, estimant que cette mesure violait leurs droits à la liberté d'expression et à la liberté de la presse garantis par le premier amendement de la Constitution américaine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: CNN, MS NOW et Politico ont poursuivi lundi le président Donald Trump et d'autres membres de son administration après leur bannissement de l'enceinte de la Maison blanche, estimant que cette mesure violait leurs droits à la liberté d'expression et à la liberté de la presse garantis par le premier amendement de la Constitution américaine. Les médias demandent à un tribunal fédéral de Washington de rendre une ordonnance restrictive temporaire pour bloquer la décision de Donald Trump, et des audiences d'urgence pourraient se tenir dès cette semaine. "Sans préavis ni procédure, la Maison blanche a révoqué les accréditations de nos journalistes parce qu'elle désapprouve nos reportages. Si rien n'est fait pour contester cette décision, cela menace la liberté de la presse et le droit du public à un journalisme indépendant, à l'abri de toute ingérence gouvernementale", ont écrit les trois organisations dans un communiqué commun. Donald Trump a annoncé cette interdiction vendredi sur les réseaux sociaux, affirmant que ces médias "ne devraient pas pouvoir constamment écrire ou rapporter des FICTIONS et des MENSONGES lorsqu'ils couvrent le président des Etats-Unis", avant de défendre sa décision dans une nouvelle publication lundi. "La Maison blanche ne mène pas une offensive contre la presse libre, à laquelle je suis très attaché. Elle mène une offensive contre les FAUSSES INFORMATIONS", écrit-il. "C'est un phénomène corrompu, délibéré, omniprésent, parfaitement coordonné et totalement hors de contrôle. C'est une menace pour notre sécurité nationale, et il faut y mettre un terme, MAINTENANT !" Les présidents américains ont déjà eu des relations conflictuelles avec la presse, mais la campagne de Donald Trump contre les médias est sans précédent. Il a bouleversé des décennies de tradition en privant de nombreux grands organes de presse d'un accès élémentaire, en lançant des attaques personnelles contre des journalistes à propos de leur travail et en favorisant des médias considérés comme plus favorables à son administration. Il a également engagé des poursuites contre plusieurs organes de presse. CNN est l'un des cinq médias, avec ABC, CBS, Fox News et NBC, constituant le principal "pool" télévisé de la Maison blanche. Selon le principe du "pool", ils partagent le coût de la couverture du président, organisent celle-ci à tour de rôle et mettent leurs images à la disposition de médias dans tout le pays. CNN devait assurer lundi la couverture en pool du déplacement de Donald Trump à New York pour l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies, mais n'a pas été en mesure de fournir les images. En réaction, toutes les autres grandes chaînes de télévision ont suspendu la couverture présidentielle en "pool". Cette décision a de fait supprimé la principale source d'images des événements de la Maison blanche alors que Donald Trump doit rencontrer de nombreux dirigeants mondiaux en marge de l'Assemblée générale et recevoir le président chinois Xi Jinping à Washington plus tard dans la semaine. "Nous vous informons qu'à compter d'aujourd'hui (lundi), le pool télévisé ne couvrira plus les événements du président désignés comme relevant de la couverture en pool", a déclaré lundi dans un courriel Bryan Boughton, qui dirige le bureau de Fox News à Washington et préside actuellement le pool télévisé. "Aucun pool de remplacement ne sera mis en place."

item.title: Mayoría de monedas sube en medio expectativa Oriente Medio y baja precios crudo
item.description: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, con la expectativa de avances diplomáticos entre Estados Unidos e Irán que además provocaban una caída en los precios del petróleo, lo que aliviaba las preocupaciones sobre la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Manuel Farías
item.content:encoded: La mayoría de las principales monedas de América Latina subieron el lunes, con la expectativa de avances diplomáticos entre Estados Unidos e Irán que además provocaban una caída en los precios del petróleo, lo que aliviaba las preocupaciones sobre la inflación. * Las bolsa de la región, en tanto, fueron respaldadas por el alza de Wall Street, donde el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) cerró en un máximo histórico. * Teherán y Washington volvieron a intercambiar amenazas el domingo, pero el presidente Donald Trump dijo que estaría dispuesto a reunirse con su par iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, quien se espera que esté en Nueva York esta semana con motivo de la Asamblea General de Naciones Unidas. * Los precios del crudo referencial Brent retrocedieron con fuerza y en un punto de la sesión cotizaron por debajo de los 100 dólares el barril por primera vez desde el 9 de septiembre. Perdieron un 3,4% a 100,34 dólares. * El presidente de la Reserva Federal de Chicago, Austan Goolsbee, afirmó que está abierto a la posibilidad de que la inflación comience a descender hasta el objetivo del 2%, pero que, si eso no ocurre, será necesario subir las tasas de interés. * Mientras, el jefe de la Fed de San Luis, Alberto Musalem, dijo a Reuters que es probable que el banco central tenga que subir aún más las tasas de interés para reducir la inflación derivada de la fuerte demanda, así como de un choque de los precios de las materias primas que ha ido más allá del petróleo. Añadió que sería mejor que el banco central actuara cuanto antes en lugar de esperar. * La Fed aumentó el costo del crédito a un rango del 3,75%-4% la semana pasada. * El peso mexicano cotizaba por la tarde sin cambios, a 17,2243 unidades por dólar, tras avanzar más temprano, con la mirada puesta en la decisión de Banco de México sobre política monetaria. El índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, revertía una leve baja de más temprano y sumaba hacia el cierre un 0,25%, a 63.535 puntos. * "Esperamos que Banco de México mantenga su tasa de referencia en 6,50% en su decisión del jueves. La inflación subyacente sigue siendo persistente y el aumento de 25 puntos base de la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] estadounidense este mes ha reducido el diferencial de tasas entre México y EEUU, lo que refuerza la cautela", dijo en una nota Phanteon. * El real brasileño sumó un 0,72% a 5,1080 por dólar la venta, mientras los inversores analizaban una nueva encuesta electoral de cara a las presidenciales del próximo mes; al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) ganó preliminarmente un 0,82% a 186.752 puntos, respaldado por el avance de los mercados externos. * El peso argentino interbancario se apreció un leve 0,03% a 1.514,5 unidades por dólar para la venta, tras una apertura negativa. Por su parte, el índice líder S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires perdió un 0,76%, tras finalizar la semana previa con una merma de un 2,48%. * La atención de los inversores se centra en la visita de una misión del Fondo Monetario Internacional para la tercera revisión del programa de 20.000 millones de dólares con el país. * El peso colombiano cerró con caída de un 0,68% a 3.199 unidades por dólar, completando seis jornadas consecutivas de pérdidas; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) , avanzó un 0,68%, a 2.565 puntos. * El peso chileno , se fortaleció un 1,29%, a 947,20/947,50 unidades por dólar, impulsado por el retroceso global del billete verde y un avance en los precios del cobre, la mayor exportación del país, tras el feriado local del viernes. En tanto, el principal índice de la bolsa de comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , cayó un 0,21%, a 11.357,82 puntos. * Los precios del cobre subieron el lunes por quinta sesión consecutiva, acercándose a máximos históricos, ya que las expectativas de un repunte estacional de la demanda en China, el mayor consumidor mundial, mantenían las compras especulativas. * La moneda peruana, el sol , se apreció un 0,15% a 3,3550/3,3560 unidades por dólar. En tanto que la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) escaló un 1,05%, a 1.576 puntos.

item.title: パラマウント、ＷＢＤ買収巡り12州と和解 買収完了へ前進
item.description:
Jody Godoy Deborah Mary Sophia
[２１日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・ス...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
パラマウント、ＷＢＤ買収巡り12州と和解　買収完了へ前進 0:15 配信

8月24日、ロサンゼルスで撮影。REUTERS/Mike Blake

Jody Godoy　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンス＜PSKY.O＞によるワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）の買収を巡り、パラマウントは買収阻止を求めて提訴していたカリフォルニア州を含む１２州と和解した。和解条件には米国内での映画製作を拡大することが盛り込まれた。カリフォルニア州のボンタ司法長官が２１日、明らかにした。これにより、買収実現に向けた大きな法的障害が取り除かれた。

ボンタ長官は記者会見で、国内での映画製作支出を年間少なくとも３億ドル上積みするほか、買収完了後は年間の映画製作本数を段階的に増やすことで合意したと明らかにした。具体的には、買収後の最初の２年間は年間３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作する。このうち毎年少なくとも４本はインディペンデント映画とし、少なくとも２０％を大作映画とする必要がある。

また和解条件に基づき、パラマウントはＣＢＳおよびＣＮＮの報道における編集上の独立性を確保するため、「報道編集独立委員会（ニュース・エディトリアル・インディペンデンス・ボード）」を設置する。

２１日午後の米国株式市場でパラマウント・スカイダンスは約８％、ＷＢＤは約１０％上昇している。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：投機筋の大規模ドル売り持ち、実体経済と矛盾する動きか コラム：進む米中デカップリング、中国「保有米国債」の脅威減退か 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 コラム：ＡＩ相場はドットコム・バブルの再来か、強気派に分がある理由 焦点：中国株、ＧＤＰ発表後も買い不発　不動産低迷で慎重ムード 最終更新: 9/22(火) 3:33 ロイター

item.title: Wall Street sube con fuerza por optimismo por la IA y baja de los rendimientos
item.description: El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraron el lunes con fuertes subidas, por las alzas de Advanced Micro Devices y otras grandes empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro retrocedieron desde máximos recientes y los precios del petróleo se desplomaron a un mínimo de 11 días por especulaciones de un avance en las negociaciones sobre Oriente Medio.
item.dc:creator: Johann Cherian, Noel Randewich
item.content:encoded: El S&P 500 y el Nasdaq cerraron el lunes con fuertes subidas, por las alzas de Advanced Micro Devices y otras grandes empresas del sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro retrocedieron desde máximos recientes y los precios del petróleo se desplomaron a un mínimo de 11 días por especulaciones de un avance en las negociaciones sobre Oriente Medio. Las acciones del sector de los chips se recuperaron, con fuertes subidas tanto de Intel (INTC.O) como de Arm Holdings . Advanced Micro Devices (AMD.O) alcanzó por primera vez una capitalización bursátil de 1 billón de dólares. Inversores mencionaron indicios que sugieren que el gasto en inteligencia artificial sigue creciendo, a pesar de las recientes advertencias sobre seguridad de los líderes de los gigantes de la IA, que desencadenaron una ola de ventas en el sector tecnológico. El rendimiento de referencia de los bonos estadounidenses a 10 años cayó a menos del 5%, mientras que los futuros del crudo Brent bajaron de los 100 dólares por barril a un mínimo desde el 9 de septiembre, pero luego se recuperaban a 100,34 dólares por barril. Mientras Washington y Teherán intercambiaban amenazas durante el fin de semana, el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo que estaría dispuesto a reunirse con el presidente iraní, Masoud Pezeshkian, cuya asistencia a la Asamblea General de la ONU en Nueva York está prevista para esta semana. "Estamos, en cierto modo, programados para seguir la evolución del precio del petróleo y el rendimiento de los bonos estadounidenses a 10 años, y si nos fijamos en esos dos factores hoy, han pasado de ser factores adversos a factores favorables para este mercado, al menos a corto plazo", dijo Art Hogan, estratega jefe de mercados de B. Riley Wealth. Las acciones de Meta (META.O) se dispararon después de que la correduría Wells Fargo elevó su precio objetivo, tras el reciente lanzamiento de Muse, su asistente de IA. Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) subió 113,72 puntos, o un 1,49%, a 7.764,22 unidades, mientras que el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) ganó 599,55 puntos, o un 2,26%, a 27.122,09. El Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) sumó 371,24 puntos, o un 0,72%, a 52.053,88 unidades.

item.title: World Bank, IMF back changes to debt framework for poor countries
item.description: The World Bank and International Monetary Fund said on Monday that both their executive boards had approved proposed reforms of their joint framework for evaluating the debt of low-income countries to reflect a more complex and riskier environment.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: The World Bank and International Monetary Fund said on Monday that both their executive boards had approved proposed reforms of their joint framework for evaluating the debt of low-income countries to reflect a more complex and riskier environment. A joint review, the first since 2017, recommended changes in several areas, including beefing up the analysis of domestic debt held by poor countries, and broadening consideration of long-term development challenges, including climate change. It stopped short of calling for a wholesale redesign. The reforms are intended to refine how the IMF and World Bank measure a country's debt-carrying capacity and provide new tools to better differentiate between countries facing some risk of debt stress and those whose debt is deemed unsustainable. The World Bank and IMF said they would also work to enhance the tools and stress tests used to ensure the consistency and accuracy of forecasts, while encouraging countries to improve reporting and transparency of their debt data. They left the discount rate used in making assessments unchanged at 5%. "Overall, our goal is a very practical one. It is to help countries identify vulnerabilities earlier and also more precisely, so that they can make better-informed financing choices and better-informed policy choices," said Allison Holland, who worked on the new debt sustainability framework and now serves as deputy director in the IMF's African Department. Holland said recent shocks had reversed improvements in the debt landscape seen since 2021, taking the number of countries at high risk or already in debt distress back to pre-pandemic levels. "Around 14% of low-income countries are in debt distress, and another 33% are at high risk. About 23% of emerging market countries are at high risk of overall sovereign stress," she said. The revised framework could help inform a debt restructuring requested earlier this month by Senegal in exchange for a $2.2 billion IMF bailout two years after a hidden debt scandal that pushed it into crisis. The IMF has said it will assess Senegal's debt sustainability using the current framework, "while taking into account the implications of the transition" to the new one. The IMF has not provided details on how the revised framework — with consideration of domestic debt — could affect Senegal's debt restructuring. TAKING EFFECT IN SECOND HALF OF 2027 The changes, which will become operational in the second half of 2027, should help countries better assess how much they can invest in needed development and climate adaptation measures while containing debt vulnerabilities over the long term, the IMF and World Bank said. A review completed in July confirmed that the debt sustainability framework, first introduced in 2005, had worked well to identify debt distress episodes ahead of time and help countries make informed borrowing and lending decisions. But it recommended changes to account for higher debt levels in many low-income countries and a shift in financing sources to include more domestic and external borrowing on commercial terms. The IMF and World Bank have a separate framework for assessing the debt sustainability of advanced and emerging market economies that will be reviewed in coming years. The IMF said near- and medium-term economic projections that feed into the analyses had generally been reliable, but longer-term forecasts of exports and revenues had shown some "optimism bias" and left data gaps, including for state-owned enterprises. The new framework introduces a long-term module to add granularity to risk assessments, as well as specific thresholds for overall public debt stress. But IMF board members agreed to temporarily hold off publishing the models used to assess unsustainable debt to give time to adjust to the new methodologies. Stand-alone staff notes would be used to share data with the board for now, it said.

BRUSSELS, Sept 21 : Efforts to combat cyberattacks across the European Union are being undermined by member states' failure to share enough information on the incidents, the European Court of Auditors said on Monday.  The 27-nation bloc was investing more and more in cybersecurity — with €1.4 billion ($1.61 billion) in its current budget — and improving cooperation, according to the court, which reports on how effectively the EU spends money. But this was not working as well as it should, it added. Poor information sharing was the "Achilles heel of the entire system", the report said.

"When a serious cyber incident occurs, timely and actionable information is essential. Without it, networks and mechanisms lose much of their added value," it added. It pointed to a ransomware attack on a technology provider for the aviation industry in September 2025, which disrupted airports in London, Brussels, Berlin, Dublin and other hubs.  None of the affected states notified the EU cybersecurity agency or other members of the incident, the report said. Individual countries' national security legislation was getting in the way when countries needed to share information about incidents that crossed borders, the court said. No EU state has reported a "large-scale" cybersecurity incident since 2016, even though that label officially applies to any attack affecting at least two members, it added.     In July, the European Commission referred France, Ireland, the Netherlands and Spain to the EU Court of Justice for failing to adjust their national laws to include EU measures on sharing cybersecurity information.
